items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: Then I got another piano player, Dave.

ctx.x: And tell me about Little Brother, so I can get him word, so he can come with me because he is my piano player. Then I got another piano player, Dave. He is almost as good -- he plays just about as good as Little Brother. Of course, I'd rather have Little Brother, because he's more familiar. But Dave is just as good. If I can't get Little Brother, Dave is all right.
Maybe after you had all your power cut off and the heat cut off, maybe you'll write some new blues about that.
